episodes.synopsis: Goro leaves Kaido High and considers transferring to Mifune High, but he reconsiders after watching Mifune dominate a preliminary match.
episodes.title: Star from Zero

episodes.synopsis: Goro tries to form a baseball team at Seishu High, but gets a cold response from the other boys. He receives support from a girl named Nakamura.
episodes.title: New Friends

episodes.synopsis: A losing streak has Shigeno in bad spirits. The school chairperson tells Goro that she can't approve of a team until he has teacher supervision.
episodes.title: From Father to Son

episodes.synopsis: Baseball club supervisor Yamada nets a practice match with Teijin High. Goro leads the team with his fast pitching but things take an unexpected turn.
episodes.title: Reckless Gamble

episodes.synopsis: Seishu ties the game with Fujii's hit, but Tashiro is still not satisfied. Goro speaks honestly after Yamada asks him why he's taking such a gamble.
episodes.title: New ground

episodes.synopsis: Goro's team begins training. Shigeno shows up as a temporary coach but an intentionally harsh practice session causes most of the team to quit.
episodes.title: Each One

episodes.synopsis: Under Shigeno's coaching, the team begins training in earnest with the goal of winning a preliminary game by spring. A new guy shows up at practice.
episodes.title: Abrupt visitor

episodes.synopsis: Seishu plays a practice match against Kaido's reserve team. They struggle with the opposing pitcher and fall behind thanks to some poor fielding.
episodes.title: Egashira conspiracy

episodes.synopsis: Goro is dejected when he hears it will take three months to recover from his injury. Kaido High's chief manager Egashira visits him in the hospital.
episodes.title: Ace absence

episodes.synopsis: The team is excited to play Yoka High in the first round of the tournament. Looking healthy, Goro throws a perfect fastball in practice.
episodes.title: Contagious Fighting Spirit

episodes.synopsis: After a fierce seventh-inning comeback, Seishu trails by just three points. Despite his injury, Goro takes the mound in place of an unmotivated Taiga.
episodes.title: Wounded Ace

episodes.synopsis: The doctor tells Goro that his career is in jeopardy if he keeps playing hurt. Goro appears to take his advice but secretly looks for other options.
episodes.title: Battle against Mifune, Start!

episodes.synopsis: Seishu faces Mifune High in the second round. Taiga loses his focus as Mifune breaks the deadlock to take the lead in the bottom of the fourth inning.
episodes.title: Climax! Mifune Battle

episodes.synopsis: Mifune has no outs and a batter on second base in the bottom of the sixth inning. Thrown by Mifune's unexpected tactics, Seishu falls further behind.
episodes.title: Willpower vs. Willpower

episodes.synopsis: Goro takes the mound in place of Taiga with two outs and the bases loaded. Komori is flustered by Goro's fastball, which looks to be at full strength.
episodes.title: Full Swing!

episodes.synopsis: After pitching a no-hitter in the third game, Goro catches the attention of Yokohama Blue Oceans scout Katsuragi, who proposes the team draft him.
episodes.title: Unexpected Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Scouting the competition, Goro is taken aback by the improvement of their next opponent, Kuriyama High. Later, he runs into Katori before the game.
episodes.title: Pitching Battle!

episodes.synopsis: The game with Kuriyama High nears its end. Karasawa hits a two-run homer to take the lead and Katori corners Seishu with two outs in the ninth inning.
episodes.title: Last Spurt!

episodes.synopsis: Tashiro pushes the team hard during training ahead of its match against Kaido. Goro objects when the doctor tells him he can't practice for the game.
episodes.title: Challenge to the Top

episodes.synopsis: When Goro underestimates the opposing pitcher Ichihara, Seishu's hopes of taking an early lead are pinned on their only remaining batter, Tashiro.
episodes.title: Chance! Manual Baseball

episodes.synopsis: Goro gives up his first hit during the bottom of a rainy third inning. He quickly makes up for his error by using a trick play to eliminate Kusano.
episodes.title: Toshiya's Secret Plan

episodes.synopsis: Ichihara is flustered after giving up hits to both Taiga and Uchiyama. But his pitching only gets worse when Tashiro steps up to bat.
episodes.title: Head to Head Battle

episodes.synopsis: Kaido buckles under Goro's all-out attack. All signs point to a pitcher's game, but Seishu's defense begins to struggle in the seventh inning.
episodes.title: A Close Fight

episodes.synopsis: After Taiga's batting pulls Seishu ahead, Kaido finally sends in their ace pitcher Mayumura. Goro is soon caught off guard by Mayumura's fastball.
episodes.title: The End of the Strategy

episodes.synopsis: The game enters extra innings, but Goro's right ankle is reaching its limit. When Tashiro says they should forfeit, Goro speaks from the heart.
episodes.title: Ace Full of Injuries

episodes.synopsis: Goro watches from home as Kaido wins at Koshien. Later, he spends valuable time with his friends at a summer festival after being invited by Tashiro.
episodes.title: Towards Your Dreams
